story.title: Amma learns to cook delicious Pooris!
paragraphs_en: Amma was about 10 years old at that time.She was so cute and a cheerful girl too. One day, Amma had a cooking competition in her school and she was forced to take part in it as it was compulsory for all the students. Amma kept on thinking... And finally she decided to take part in it. Amma did not know how to cook and she had to ask paati (paati means granny in tamil) about this.

When Amma was back from school, she ran quickly and told Paati about the competition and Paati asked her what she wanted to cook.But Amma had no idea about it. She thought for a while and said,"POORIS!!!!" So Amma and Paati both of them started the preparation. First,Paati told Amma to add salt , dough , warm water , few drops of oil and mix them well in a large bowl and make small & round dough balls with it. Then , she told her to heat the oil for frying Pooris at a medium heat.

Then she had to fry it till the pooris became golden brown. Then, Amma served them in a plate to Paati and Paati enjoyed them alot!! The next day, Amma was ready.... Paati had given her some channa masala so that people could enjoy more. Amma made tasty and puffy Pooris . The aroma was so good. Her Pooris were the tastiest!
Amma won the first prize and she was awarded as the " THE BEST COOK" ! Both Amma and Paati were very happy. And that's how Amma learnt to cook delicious Pooris.
